title: Communication Design Intern
note: For current design students; apply by email with portfolio, resume in English and Chinese, and cover letter; Chinese is a plus, not required.

facts.summary: Graphic/communication design intern at the TEAMS Shanghai studio.
facts.duties: Social media visuals, support on packaging, labels, graphics and print files, event materials, basic photo and video.
facts.requirements: Currently studying design; Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign; strong layout and visual communication.
facts.apply: Email only, via the address on the posting, with process portfolio, bilingual resume and cover letter.
